name: reminders.create
description: Create a local reminder in the user's private reminder store.

args_schema.title: short reminder text
args_schema.due_at: ISO datetime when the reminder is due
args_schema.event_at: optional ISO datetime for the event being remembered
args_schema.location: optional address/place from user text or memory context
args_schema.action_url: optional link for the reminder action, such as a Google Maps directions/search URL
args_schema.notes: optional notes or original user request
